aliases: Fe-7Al AIMFC cold-rolled and annealed sheet

processing_steps.method: air induction melting with flux cover (AIMFC)
processing_steps.atmosphere: air, with protective flux cover (Al2O3, CaO, MgO, CaF2)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: 30-kg heats in an Inductotherm medium-frequency AIM furnace of 50-kg capacity; commercial purity Al and Fe; Fe charge cleaned by pickling in dilute HCl; flux added after melting Fe; cleaned/preheated Al plunged into molten Fe; melt top poured into split cast iron molds.
80-mm-diameter AIMFC ingot preheated in a hearth furnace at 1373 K for 1 h and hot-forged in a 1-tonne pneumatic forge hammer with die platens at room temperature.

24-mm-thick forged sections preheated at 1373 K for 1 h and hot rolled by 50% with 1-mm reduction in thickness per pass; samples reheated after every six rolling passes; final thickness of the hot-rolled plate was 12 mm.
Cold rolled to thin sheets (2 mm) and foils (Fig. 3); cold-rolling reduction ratio and temperature are not reported.
Annealed after cold rolling to produce the cold-rolled and annealed sheet; annealing temperature and time are not reported in the text.

structures.overall_structure: Totally disordered Fe-Al solid solution (single phase)

phases_present.phase_name: disordered Fe-Al solid solution (Fe-7 wt.% Al)

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Room-temperature tensile ductility of AIMFC-produced Fe-7Al is comparable to VIM-produced Fe-7Al; AIMFC properties are superior to AIM.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Room temperature; 2-mm-thick cold-rolled and annealed sheet
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure ultimate tensile strength, yield strength and total elongation of the cold-rolled and annealed AIMFC Fe-7Al sheet.
characterization_methods.key_findings: UTS 467 ± 5.8 MPa; YS 340 ± 8.1 MPa; EL total 40 ± 3.5%.

characterization_methods.purpose: Determine the chemical composition of the AIMFC Fe-7Al ingot.

unmapped_findings: Measured chemical composition of the AIMFC Fe-7Al ingot (Table I): Al 7.30, Si 0.14, Mn 0.045, S 0.0016, C 0.019, O 0.0057, H 0.0023, N 0.0018 wt.% (Fe balance). Hydrogen analysed by RH-444 Leco gas analyzer.
Fe-7 wt.% Al alloy represents a totally disordered solid solution alloy (single phase), unlike Fe-9 wt.% Al which is expected to exhibit short-range ordering.
Fe-Al alloys containing 6-9 wt.% Al show about a 10% reduction in density ('lightweight steels'); a general iron-aluminum alloy density of 6.7 g/cm3 is quoted in the gas-porosity discussion.

The cold-rolled and annealed AIMFC Fe-7Al sheet (2 mm thick) exhibited excellent room-temperature ductility (~40% total elongation); Fe-7Al by VIM and AIMFC could be cold-rolled to thin sheets and foils (Fig. 3).

No annealing temperature/time or cold-rolling reduction ratio is reported for the cold-rolled and annealed sheet; no specific cold-rolled-and-annealed microstructure (grain size/texture) is described in the text.
